content: General sub-function supported NRC check The DSD shall send the negative response NRC 0x12 (sub-functionNotSupported ), if for the pro- cessed service no configured DcmDsdSubService exists with the DcmDsdSubSer- viceId of the processed service. This NRC check shall not be done for UDS Service 0x31 (RoutineControl).
